tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Fuller notes for an unusual request: overview, music, styles, editing, publishing, capabilities. Read-only, free.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Make a faceless video from an idea or a script, with no footage: the style’s pictures, designed screens, captions and sound. Send exactly one of idea (Clypmint writes the narration) or script (spoken exactly as supplied), which sets the length, so leave seconds out. Defaults to a 30-second vertical

tools.name: import_asset
tools.description: Import one image or song up to 32 MiB: an attached file (file), or a public https link (url, for Claude and hosts with no attachments). logo: true marks the brand’s logo. tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List the pictures, clips and songs saved in the linked account, with the asset ids that go in asset_ids.

tools.name: get_social_accounts
tools.description: Read connected publishing accounts and their current availability for the linked Clypmint account. Requires separate publishing consent.

tools.name: connect_social_accounts
tools.description: Create a private authorization link for connecting social accounts to the linked Clypmint account. The account owner chooses networks and grants access on the provider’s authorization screen. Does not publish content.

tools.name: upload_for_post
tools.description: Make an upload link for a finished video file the user has (MP4 or MOV, up to 1 GB), to post with schedule_post mediaId. Returns media_id, upload_url (one hour) and the curl command that sends the file. Does not post.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: With several connected accounts, connectionId (from get_social_accounts) names the one the user chose. Schedules one video for external publication at postAt, from exactly one source: a Clypmint video (videoId, outputId, expectedEditId), an upload (mediaId) or a public link (mediaUrl). Requires the

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Read the linked account’s content calendar and publishing receipts, optionally within a time range. Includes pending, scheduled, partial, failed and published outcomes.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Change the caption or publication time of an existing scheduled post identified by post_id. Returns the updated publishing receipt.

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled post identified by post_id and return its publishing receipt. Does not delete already-published platform content.

tools.name: fix_captions
tools.description: Fix caption words or the key-word colour of a finished video, without a new edit; timing stays. Either rewrite lines (from and to are source word numbers from get_transcript) or swap words everywhere with replace: [{ heard, spelled }] (brand names, people). Each spoken word keeps a caption word. 5 a

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the versions of a video, newest last, and which one is live. Use with restore_version to undo. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Undo: make an earlier version live again (version_id from list_versions). Nothing is deleted; the replaced version can be restored the same way. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Stops an awaited upload (import_id), an edit (video_id) or a style copy (style_id). The saved video stays as it was; credits_left says the balance. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: save_clip
tools.description: Keep a finished output of a video (output_id from check_video) as a reusable asset; its asset_id goes in asset_ids of edit_video or create_video. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Keep one lasting preference for this brand's later videos, in plain words (caption size, pace, sounds, colours, a name's spelling). A newer one on the same thing wins; list_memory shows them, forget removes one. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: list_memory
tools.description: List what Clypmint remembers for a brand, each with the id forget takes. Read it before remember, to avoid repeats. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Forget one remembered preference by its id from list_memory. Later videos leave it out; videos already made stay as they are. Cost: Free: no credits.

tools.name: schedule_plan
tools.description: Schedule many finished videos at once. approve: false checks every slot (video ready, output, time 2 min to 60 days ahead, connected accounts) and changes nothing; approve: true, after the user’s explicit yes to that schedule, schedules the ready ones and says which are still editing. Needs publishi

tools.name: get_basic_info
tools.description: Shape, length, fps, version and limits. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Layers and every overlay. layer_id: one graphic's whole scene, to change it. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Spoken words (number, start, end, source number), paged. cut takes word numbers; fix_captions source numbers. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Up to 6 moments, or one filmstrip (from, to, every). Look before a change and after. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: The film as JSON and all the renderer can draw. Cost: Free.

tools.name: measure_motion
tools.description: Times a move frame by frame (a clip on the video, or a graphic) and names its ease, with a graph. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Editing guide. Read start once, and graphics before write_graphic. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_font_family_info
tools.description: Fonts for captions, overlays, and graphics. Cost: Free.

tools.name: import_font
tools.description: Keeps a font for this account (a TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 link or file, or an open catalog family) after checking its license allows embedding; write_graphic then draws it by family. Cost: Free.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Search sound effects by meaning. Place one with set_audio. Cost: Free.

tools.name: find_broll
tools.description: Web clips, real media and stock, vision-checked. Cost: $0.06 a search ($0.02 with web false), only when verified shots come back.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Brings a picture, clip or song in from a link or a local file, and returns its asset_id. Cost: Free.

tools.name: put_overlay
tools.description: Text, a picture or a clip for chosen seconds; overlay_id replaces one. Cost: Free.

tools.name: write_graphic
tools.description: 2D or 3D motion as a scene (read get_guide graphics): eased keys, per-letter text, clip masks, vector shapes, 3D meshes with matcap, a perspective camera, particles, imported clips as video on pictures and 3D surfaces; or Lottie JSON. Any length. To change one: get_timeline layer_id, then replaces.

tools.name: apply_document
tools.description: Any change: RFC 6902 patch on get_project's film. Cost: Free.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.description: One layer: place, text, colour, visibility, times or media. Cost: Free.

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.description: Removes an ov_ or vo_ layer, or hides a layer; cut takes time out. Cost: Free.

tools.name: cut
tools.description: Take time out by seconds or word numbers; the gap closes. Cost: Free.

tools.name: set_captions
tools.description: Change the caption block. Rewrite chosen lines with fix_captions. Cost: Free.

tools.name: set_audio
tools.description: Music, exact sound effects, the style's own effects, and the footage sound. Cost: Free.

tools.name: add_voiceover
tools.description: Narrate a script from a second (a vo_ layer). Cost: 1 credit a started minute of voice-over.

tools.name: set_look
tools.description: Grade, camera, shape, speaker cut-out, a replay, or style_id to switch the whole video to a style. Cost: Free.

tools.name: add_clip
tools.description: Puts another of their videos in, with its own sound. Cost: Free.

tools.name: exchange_project
tools.description: Import an After Effects comp, or export Premiere, After Effects, or a portable project (an owned download link). Cost: Free.

tools.name: project_notes
tools.description: Lists the video's pinned notes; mark one working or done with its reply. Cost: Free.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: What the user has open and selected in Clypmint: the video, the second, the layers. Read it when they say "this" or name no video. Cost: Free.

tools.name: finish_working
tools.description: Call when done changing a video: clears your label and gives the link to end with. Cost: Free.

tools.name: start_video
tools.description: A video with no footage: a title card, or a graphics base, at 24, 25, 30 or 60 fps. Cost: Free.

tools.name: open_canvas
tools.description: Shows the Clypmint canvas: their videos, or one video with its timeline, to watch your changes and select layers. Cost: Free.

tools.name: canvas_live
tools.description: Only the canvas app calls this. Cost: Free.

tools.name: canvas_select
tools.description: Only the canvas app calls this. Cost: Free.

tools.name: browse_styles
tools.description: List the styles only when the user asks to see or choose a style, or names one; not for an edit that names no style. Lists ready styles and saved copies (own, style_version), shapes, uses and preset inputs; any style works from footage or words. Includes 21 narrator auditions. Use returned style_id

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Brings the footage in for you to edit; no Clypmint model touches it (every word captioned), delivered ready. Then read get_timeline and get_transcript. Edit with cut, set_captions, put_overlay, write_graphic, set_audio, set_look. Hooks, shorts and clips stay with Clypmint's editor. style_id sets its

tools.name: check_video
tools.description: Check a video and show it, waiting for news while it is being made. state is waiting (upload link in the answer), uploading, editing, ready, draft (a rough cut, not the finished edit; next_step says how to finish it), cancelled, or failed (problem says why). A download link: with_download: true.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the linked account's 20 most recent videos, each with its id (the video_id other tools take), title, state and length. check_video shows one in full.

tools.name: copy_style
tools.description: Copy a reference link or file into a style; with none, get a private upload link. clone: monthly copies included, then 25 credits. match: approximate and included. dry_run: quote only.

tools.name: adjust_style
tools.description: Change one of the linked account's saved styles in plain words, for example 'bigger yellow captions, no zooms' or 'open on the strongest line'. Saves it as the style's next version; every later video in that style follows it, and earlier versions are kept. Preserve operation_id on retries.

tools.name: get_account_identity
tools.description: Return only the stable identity and display labels of the account represented by this request. Used for account linking. For account rights, credits and usage use get_profile.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the Clypmint profile linked to this request, with its credits (used and included this billing month, and when they renew) and videos used, so you can say what a request will use before spending. own_styles: their saved styles.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render a video. Returns a link, an ETA in seconds and a price. Load skill://clypmint/render/<engine>.md.

tools.name: render_frames
tools.description: Render still pictures at the given times, in seconds.

tools.name: render_job
tools.description: Read a render, or wait until it changes state.

tools.name: render_cancel
tools.description: Stop a render. Pictures already made stay saved.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_transcript · Private data: import_asset, connect_social_accounts, upload_for_post, import_font, import_media, apply_document, edit_video, copy_style · Public sink: create_video, connect_social_accounts, upload_for_post, schedule_post, update_post, cancel_post, cancel_job, edit_video, check_video, copy_style · Destructive: create_video, cancel_post, delete_layer, edit_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_transcript · Private data: import_asset, connect_social_accounts, upload_for_post, import_font, import_media, apply_document, edit_video, copy_style · Public sink: create_video, connect_social_accounts, upload_for_post, schedule_post, update_post, cancel_post, cancel_job, edit_video, check_video, copy_style · Destructive: create_video, cancel_post, delete_layer, edit_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
